# Continuous CPU & Memory Profiling with Pyroscope

Always-on continuous profiling in production with Grafana Pyroscope: CPU sampling, memory allocation flamegraphs, and zero overhead.

## Invariants
- PROFILING_OVERHEAD_MUST_NOT_EXCEED_2_PERCENT
- TAG_FLAMEGRAPHS_WITH_RELEASE_VERSIONS
- COMPARE_BEFORE_AND_AFTER_CPU_ALLOCATIONS
